items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: a lot of men came out of there like John Best

ctx.x: The Dan Murphy's Musical Skipper's. For a very short while, I was with Hank [Viogrin] -- now he was another old man, but he had a little better musical talents, and a lot of men came out of there like John Best --
Oh, the trumpet player. Lives in California now.
